reason: Northstar primarily provides deterministic testing and debugging of AI-generated Python implementations and data-processing artifacts through multi-layer exams, reference checks, invariant checks, and verdict reports.

summaries.zh: Northstar 用多层确定性检查、参考实现比对和不变量验证来评估 AI 生成的 Python 实现及数据处理结果，并输出判定报告。
summaries.en: Northstar evaluates AI-generated Python implementations and data-processing artifacts with deterministic multi-layer checks, reference comparisons, and invariant validation, then produces verdict reports.

capabilities: Executes submitted Python implementations in deterministic multi-layer exams
Compares candidate outputs with statistical and independent reference checks
Generates JSON and HTML verdict reports
Runs examiner workflows through an MCP stdio gateway
Maintains deterministic rejection, memory, and trust profiles
